what: recipe_ids withdrawn from the release, by population. IDS ONLY — the quarantine records themselves are deliberately not published, because they hold the scraped rows the withdrawal removed.
why: release_config.py reads these so verify_release.py's exclusion check can run on a clone. Without them it raised FileNotFoundError before any check ran, and the alternative — INDICRECIPE_ALLOW_NO_WITHDRAWN_LIST=1 — makes the check pass vacuously, which is worse than a red build.
